build.beforeDevCommand: node src-tauri/scripts/build-sidecar.mjs && bun run --cwd web dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: node src-tauri/scripts/build-sidecar.mjs && bun run --cwd web build

security.csp: default-src 'self' asset: http: https: data: blob:; connect-src ipc: http: https: ws: wss:; img-src 'self' asset: http: https: data: blob:; media-src 'self' asset: http: https: data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:;
